original.question: Jerry anorova dhiya rine mapeji matanhatu. Mukana wakadii wekuti (vakaitwa sechikamu chezana) anorova nhamba inodarika 3 kupfuura kuti anorova nhamba dzakazara mbiri dzakatevedzana?
original.answer:
Pane nhamba 49 dzinodarika 3 padhiya, saka mukana wekurova imwe yadzo ndi 49/52=94%.
Mukana wekurova nhamba imwe dzakazara ndi 50%, saka mukana wekurova mbiri dzakatevedzana ndi 50% * 50% = 25%.
Mukana wakasiyana pakati pechikamu chiviri chino ndi 94% - 25% = 69%.
